item.title: ChatGPT silently passes data between connectors and the bounty wants an ID card
item.description:

item.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part 2
item.description:
📝 01 / Finding our guest page on the host The guest and host use different physical address spaces. Walking that root gave us the host physical address of our guest page. Host processes use page tables to translate their virtual addresses into physical memory.
🔗 Read more: https://pwn.ai/blog/firecracker-escape

item.title: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research
item.description:
📝 Their reasons for believing this have been redacted. Before there was much acceleration from AI, labor roughly grew at some roughly fixed exponential rate from hiring more humans.
